h1. SCRUM-15 — Secure Card Payments — Test Strategy & Test Tasks

h2. Objective
As a registered customer, I want to pay outstanding invoices using debit/credit card so that payments are completed securely and instantly.

h2. Scope
* In-scope: Card payments via payment gateway, UI error handling (expired card, CVV), 3D Secure (3DS) flows, network/timeouts, webhook reconciliation, security (no PAN/CVV storage).
* Out-of-scope: Alternative payment methods (bank transfer), accounting reconciliation beyond webhook retry logic.

h2. Test Strategy
* Approach: Combination of automated end-to-end tests (Cucumber + Selenium) for critical flows and manual/ exploratory tests for gateway-side behaviors and DB inspections.
* Environments: Staging with payment gateway sandbox, HTTPS enabled, DB access for security verification.
* Test types: Functional (positive/negative), Security (card data handling), Integration (gateway/webhooks), Resilience (timeouts, retries), Regression (smoke).
* Test data: Use gateway-provided test card numbers (e.g., 4111111111111111) and dedicated sandbox accounts.

h2. Test Tasks (high level)
# Review user story SCRUM-15 acceptance criteria and confirm environment readiness
# Create/extend BDD feature files to cover positive and negative flows
# Implement step definitions and PageObjects or extend existing ones
# Add automated tests to CI pipeline and validate they pass against staging gateway
# Perform security checks: verify PAN/CVV not persisted in DB/logs
# Coordinate with backend to verify webhook retries and reconciliation
# Create PR and request review from QA and Backend owners

h2. Test Cases (selected — full list in repository: Automation/TestCases/SecureCardPayments_TestCases.md)
|| Test Case ID || Priority || Title || Summary || Pre-condition || Expected Result ||
| TC_CARD_01 | High | Successful card payment | Complete payment using valid card details | User logged in; unpaid invoice | Payment processed; invoice marked Paid; receipt sent |
| TC_CARD_02 | High | Expired card rejected | Expired card shows clear error | User on payment screen | Payment blocked; invoice remains unpaid |
| TC_CARD_03 | Medium | Incorrect CVV handling | CVV error prevents charging | User on payment screen | CVV error shown; no invoice update |
| TC_CARD_04 | High | Card data not persisted | PAN/CVV not stored | Payment conducted | Only token/reference stored; CVV not logged |

h2. Execution & Reporting
* Execute via Maven: mvn test -Dtest=TestRunner
* Reports: HTML cucumber report generated at target/cucumber-reports.html
* CI: Add pipeline job to run tests against staging with gateway sandbox credentials

h2. Risks & Mitigations
* Risk: Gateway test card behaviour may change — Mitigate: pin gateway sandbox version and test cards, coordinate with gateway team.
* Risk: Webhook flakiness — Mitigate: add idempotency checks, webhook retry tests and monitoring.

h2. Next Steps / Ownership
* QA: Extend step implementations for 3DS, webhook simulation, and network fault injection
* Backend: Provide DB access and webhook simulation endpoints
* DevOps: Ensure staging environment has sandbox gateway config and certificates
